import sys, os, hashlib; sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
for k in ['OPENROUTER_API_KEY', 'PLACE_MODEL']: os.environ.pop(k, None)
sys.path.insert(0, '/root/worktrees/send-c1b/backend')
from unittest.mock import Mock, patch
from dealroom_sign import placement
from dealroom_sign.tests.test_placement_r14 import in_process
from dealroom_sign.tests import placement_r24_review_cases as R24
print(placement.VERSION, hashlib.sha256(open(placement.__file__,'rb').read()).hexdigest()[:8])
rc = R24.rc; X = 72
def rows(cap, name, tail):
    return [(240, 'FLEET TEST CO.', False, X), (270, 'By:', True, X), (300, 'Date:', True, X),
            (340, 'For and on behalf of the Recipient', False, X), (370, cap, True, X), (382, name, False, X), tail,
            (520, 'HARBOR LIGHT GROUP, INC.', False, X), (560, 'By:', True, X), (600, 'Date:', True, X)]
CASES = [('Executed by: + Name + Title text, no Date', rows('Executed by:', 'Name: Pat Smith', (394, 'Title: CEO', False, X))),
         ('Authorised signatory: + Name + Title rule', rows('Authorised signatory:', 'Name: Pat Smith', (420, 'Title:', True, X))),
         ('Signatory: + Nom + Date rule', rows('Signatory:', 'Nom: Pat Smith', (420, 'Date:', True, X))),
         ('Firma: + bare name + Date rule', rows('Firma:', 'Pat Smith', (420, 'Date:', True, X))),
         ('Unterschrift: + Name + Fecha rule', rows('Unterschrift:', 'Name: Pat Smith', (420, 'Fecha:', True, X)))]
http = Mock(side_effect=AssertionError('http'))
with patch('httpx.Client.send', http):
    for name, rs in CASES:
        pdf = rc.pages_pdf([list(rc.RECITALS['parsed']), rs]); ppl = [dict(name='Pat Smith', email=rc.PE)]
        mo = Mock(); r = placement.place(pdf, ppl, model_client=mo)
        m2 = Mock(); r2 = in_process(placement, pdf, ppl, m2)
        print(name, '|', r['status'], r['reason_code'], len(r['fields']), 'model', mo.call_count, m2.call_count, 'worker==inproc', r == r2)
print('http', http.call_count)
